info.name: tamagotchi-service
info.description:
Tamagotchi creation, stats, primary choice, XP and ownership transfer.

Owner: dan1el50. Port: 8083 (reached through the gateway on 8080).

Everything goes through the API Gateway (`{{gatewayUrl}}`): players register and log in at User Management through it, and the gateway verifies their token and forwards requests with `X-User-Id` + `X-Gateway-Key` instead. Battle (`xp`, `transfer-owner`) and Monster Raid (`GET /tamagotchis/{id}`) call through the Message Broker (`{{brokerUrl}}`) with the broker's `X-Broker-Key` and their own `X-Service-Key`, and no token; the gateway no longer forwards calls between services. Battle's calls carry an `idempotencyKey`, and the run publishes a `battle.ended` twice to show the XP is awarded once. The service accepts nothing else - the `... without the gateway` request shows the 401. Each run registers new players (`{{runId}}`), so it can be run repeatedly.

Stat updates are checked against the package's stat definitions in Package Registry (through the gateway), so the setup folder registers a real package. Package Registry's admin is seeded by user id (PACKAGE_REGISTRY_INITIAL_ADMIN_USER_ID, `admin-1`), which no gateway login can be, so that one folder calls Package Registry directly and plays the gateway.

Set these to the values in your .env (the defaults match .env.example): `{{gatewayKey}}` = GATEWAY_KEY, `{{battleServiceKey}}` = SERVICE_KEY_BATTLE, `{{monsterRaidServiceKey}}` = SERVICE_KEY_MONSTER_RAID. With newman: `--env-var gatewayKey=<key>` and so on.

item.description: Tamagotchi's steps of the battle-settlement and raid-rewards sagas (POST /saga-steps, broker key only), called here through the broker's queue for Tamagotchi as the coordinator would call them. Every step is undone again, so the folder leaves the Tamagotchis as it found them.

item.name: add-xp: 300 XP to the winner's primary (level 3 -> 4)

exec: pm.test('one change, now level 4', function () { var c = pm.response.json().result.changed; pm.expect(c).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(c[0].level).to.eql(4); });

item.name: The same step again changes nothing
Level 4, once
Compensate: exactly that XP comes off (level 4 -> 3)

exec: pm.test('one change undone, back to level 3', function () { var u = pm.response.json().result.undone; pm.expect(u).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(u[0].level).to.eql(3); });

exec: pm.test('the owner\'s primary got 40 XP, the other player is skipped', function () { var r = pm.response.json().result; pm.expect(r.changed).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(r.changed[0].tamagotchiId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('secondaryTamagotchiId')); pm.expect(r.skipped).to.have.lengthOf(1); });
